name: Congo Free State, Belgian Congo and DR Congo
summary: The Congo basin under Belgian king Leopold II’s Congo Free State (1885–1908), notorious for forced labour and atrocities, then the Belgian Congo, and independent since 1960 (called Zaire 1971–97).

knownFor.label: Congolese rumba
knownFor.note: Music recognised by UNESCO, popular across Africa.

knownFor.label: Inga dams
knownFor.note: Hydroelectric dams on the Congo River.

knownFor.label: Cobalt
knownFor.note: The DRC mines most of the world’s cobalt, used in batteries.
